detaileddescription.para: Sample format
Takes a linear volume and converts it to a logarithmic used by RPG_RT (Direct Sound). Do not use this for Midi, is already logarithmic by design.

Writes 'size' bytes in the specified buffer. The data matches the format reported by GetFormat. When size is is smaller then the amount of written bytes or an error occurs the remaining buffer space is cleared.

parameterdescription.para: Size of the buffer in bytes

simplesect.para: Number of bytes written to the buffer or -1 on error

detaileddescription.para: Decodes the whole audio sample. The data matches the format reported by GetFormat.
Rewinds the audio stream to the beginning.
Gets if the audio stream will loop when the stream finishes.
Enables/Disables audio stream looping. When looping is enabled IsFinished will never return true and the stream auto-rewinds (assuming Rewind is supported)
Gets the number of loops
Assigns a stream to the audio decoder. Open should be only called once per audio decoder instance. Use GetError to get the error reason on failure.

simplesect.para: true if initializing was successful, false otherwise

detaileddescription.para: Pauses the audio decoding.
Resumes the audio decoding.
Gets the current volume of the audio decoder. Fades are considered.
Sets the current volume of the audio decoder.
Prepares a volume fade in/out effect. To do a fade out begin must be larger then end. Call Update to do the fade.
Seeks in the audio stream. The value of offset is implementation defined but is guaranteed to match the result of Tell. Libraries must support at least seek from the start for Rewind().
Determines whether the stream is finished.
Updates the volume for the fade in/out effect.

parameterdescription.para: Time in us since the last call of this function.

detaileddescription.para: Updates Midi output. Only used by Midi out devices. For Midi out devices this must be called at least once per ms.

parameterdescription.para: Time in us since the last call of this function.

detaileddescription.para: Retrieves the format of the audio decoder. It is guaranteed that these settings will stay constant the whole time.

parameterdescription.para: Filled with the amount of channels

detaileddescription.para: Requests a preferred format from the audio decoder. Not all decoders support everything and it's recommended to use the audio hardware for audio processing. When false is returned use GetFormat to get the real format of the output data.

simplesect.para: true when all settings were set, otherwise false (use GetFormat)

detaileddescription.para: Gets the pitch multiplier.
Sets the pitch multiplier. 100 = normal speed 200 = double speed and so on When not supported a resampler will handle the pitch shift.

simplesect.para: true if pitch was set, false otherwise

detaileddescription.para: Tells the current stream position. The value is implementation defined.
Returns a value suitable for the GetMidiTicks command. For MIDI this is the amount of MIDI ticks, for other formats usually the playback position in seconds.

simplesect.para: Amount of MIDI ticks or position in seconds

detaileddescription.para: Gets the status of the newly created audio decoder. Used to make sure the underlying library is properly initialized.

simplesect.para: true if initializing was succesful, false otherwise

detaileddescription.para: Provides an error message when Open or a Decode function fail.
Returns the name of the format the current audio decoder decodes in lower case.
Called by the Decode functions to fill the buffer.

simplesect.para: number of bytes read or -1 on error

detaileddescription.para: The AudioDecoder class provides an abstraction over the decoding of common audio formats. This is the base class containing shared logic. See AudioDecoder for sample based decoding and AudioDecoderMidi for Midi event based decoding.
